fields.title: Leave database failover coordinated outside the client
fields.decision: Do not provide native automatic failover to a standby database server; permit callers to build failover by updating connection properties in the configuration hierarchy.
fields.context: High-availability and disaster-recovery approaches vary across DNS, provider configuration, and infrastructure coordination. A robust strategy cannot be assumed at an individual client.

alternatives.option: Have an individual ArgentSea client automatically fail over to a standby database.
alternatives.whyRejected: Business-continuity failover requires coordinated infrastructure signals; an uncoordinated client could make a rogue failover decision.

fields.consequences: ArgentSea remains compatible with high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions while avoiding an opinionated native policy; callers can select their own trigger and update endpoints or database names.

sources.label: Failover boundary and configuration update capability
